description: Strict structured output: valid JSON matching a schema first try — no wrapper, no fences, no extra text.
name: Structured Output

tasks.prompt: Return a JSON object with the key city (string) for Paris. Output only the JSON object, no other text.
Return a JSON object with the keys title (string) and pages (integer) for the book Dune, which has 412 pages. Output only the JSON object, no other text.
Return a JSON array of three numbers: 4, 8, 15. Output only the JSON array, no other text.
Return a JSON object with the keys planet (string) and satellites (integer) for Jupiter, which has 95 satellites. Output only the JSON object, no other text.
Return a JSON object with the keys fruit (string) and colour (string) for a mango, which is orange. Output only the JSON object, no other text.
Return a JSON object with the keys name (string) and age (integer) for Emma, who is 29. Output only the JSON object, no other text.
Return a JSON array of three colour names: red, green, blue. Output only the JSON array, no other text.
Return a JSON object with the keys mountain (string) and height (integer) for Everest, which is 8848 metres tall. Output only the JSON object, no other text.
Return a JSON object with the keys dish (string), servings (integer) and vegetarian (boolean) for a tomato soup that serves 4 and is vegetarian. Output only the JSON object, no other text.
Return a JSON object with the keys team (string) and players (array of strings) for the Rovers, whose players are Ana and Ben. Output only the JSON object, no other text.
